objs.name: document
objs.description: Document managed in DHC VISION including policies, guidelines, work instructions.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Attachment bound to a Document. Could be Additional Info, Information Object, or Equippment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: An additional information object attached to a Document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Equipment attached to a Document; has its own versioning.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: An information object that can be attached to a Document.

objs.name: template
objs.description: Document template used for document creation and metadata.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changes to a Document, managed in its own folder.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations and distribution.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Edit an existing document.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert saved document to PDF and display on web.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Release process for a document (Creator - Review - Release).

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: All workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language, and check/release the translation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: manage_change_proposals
evts.description: Manage Change proposals for a document.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extend validity by author, reviewer and releaser with information to authors, co-authors and reviewers.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Process for AKS; override by applicant, reviewer and releaser.

evts.name: reactivate
evts.description: Reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Override of release; invalidate and archive documents.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribute documents to readers or groups.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify distribution by email.

evts.name: acknowledge_distribution
evts.description: Acknowledgement of distribution.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Create a new version during editing or release.

evts.name: link_document_to_master_data
evts.description: Link documents to Master data or other documents via metadata fields.

evts.name: attach_object
evts.description: Attach an object to a document (Attachment).

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign readers to a document.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign authors to a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign co-authors to a document.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers to a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers to a document.

evts.name: assign_translator
evts.description: Assign translator to a document.

o2o.description: Document can have Information Object attachments.
Document uses Template for creation and metadata.
Document is created by or acted on by Users (authors, reviewers, etc.).
Change Proposals are created/edited/reviewed by Users.
